run_baseline_agent_evaluation: run the baseline OpenVocabManipAgent evaluation in local mode using default habitat and agent config files
run_random_agent_evaluation: run a RandomAgent evaluation for a specified number of episodes in the OVMM environment
run_exploration_agent_evaluation: run an OVMMExplorationAgent evaluation with configurable force step and data directory options
run_remote_evaluation: run agent evaluation in remote mode by setting evaluation_type to remote with custom config overrides
run_vectorized_evaluation: run agent evaluation in local_vectorized mode with a specified number of episodes and data collection
